about_the_game:
Enter WARD, a PS1-style psychological short horror experience inspired by retro horror games. You awaken inside a decaying hospital ward, trapped in looping corridors that twist reality with every cycle. Each loop changes the world around you, hiding clues, puzzles, and unsettling events that reveal fragments of the story.

To escape, you’ll need to piece together cryptic messages, pay attention to small details, and confront the horrors lurking within the ward. Nothing is ever the same twice—hallways shift, sounds mislead, and the environment itself becomes your enemy. With a haunting retro aesthetic, chilling sound design, and an atmosphere of constant dread, WARD pulls players into a nightmare that blurs the lines between reality and hallucination.

Features

  • Short but intense psychological horror experience

  • Looping corridor gameplay with shifting events and environments

  • Cryptic puzzles and environmental storytelling

  • Disturbing sound design and unsettling atmosphere

  • Retro-inspired visuals that capture the feel of classic horror

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains jumpscares, depictions of violence, and loud or disturbing sounds that may not be suitable for all players. Player discretion is advised.
